primaryChecks.text: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;
primaryChecks.previousContext: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;
primaryChecks.nextContext: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: この節は地域表現を直接述べる。部族・祖先の人物IDとは区別し、本文が明示する範囲以上を推定しない。

primaryChecks.text: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
primaryChecks.previousContext: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: この節は地域表現を直接述べる。部族・祖先の人物IDとは区別し、本文が明示する範囲以上を推定しない。

wikipediaRead.title: Tribe of Benjamin
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 記事はベニヤミン族とその割当地域を別に説明し、後者の大まかな範囲を記す。部族記事は地域との関連を示す資料であり、4:18の行政表現と部族そのものを同一視しない。

candidateCoordinate.reasonJa: 地域の不確かな広がりを一つの点で表すと範囲の誤認を招くため、候補地点を示さない。
